# Fate UI v0.8.10-beta14

The 0.8.10 line: a real multi-folder workspace, a macOS browser fix, and one-click in-app auto-update.

## Multi-folder workspace

- Run several project folders in one window, each with its own live Pi agent that stays running while you work elsewhere.
- Switch folders freely — even while another folder is still starting or streaming. Folders are isolated agents, so clicking a session in another folder is never blocked.
- Session lists carry over and stay in the same order (recent / oldest / alphabetical / manual) whether a folder is focused or not, with no reload flash.
- Every folder's agent stays alive (idle eviction is off); re-opening a folder with a live agent is instant.
- Collapsed folders stay quiet (count chip only); expand to see sessions. Compact session rows are unified across active and inactive folders so nothing visibly changes on focus.

## Conversation paths (forks)

- The active branch is the main session and is no longer duplicated as a "Current path" row.
- Forks render with their own content (left-aligned, lighter than the session title), no "Alternate path N" labels, no redundant arrow.
- Each fork has a hover actions menu with Rename and Compact (navigate-to-fork-then-act). Clone / fork / isolated-worktree are not offered on forks to avoid infinite nesting.

## Browser

- Fixed an infinite-loading hang on macOS: the per-request network gate now bounds its DNS lookup, so typing a URL and pressing Enter loads the page instead of spinning forever.

## In-app auto-update

- Check for Updates in Settings now offers a Download & install button for the latest version.
- It downloads the correct installer for your OS (Windows NSIS, macOS DMG, Linux AppImage) from the public GitHub release, shows download progress, then installs and relaunches.

## Compatibility and installers

No migration is needed. Existing projects, Pi sessions, settings, themes, and folder history are unchanged.

GitHub Actions builds and tests this release on Windows x64, macOS Apple Silicon, macOS Intel, and Linux x64. The prerelease contains the installers plus SHA256SUMS:

- Windows x64: NSIS .exe
- macOS arm64 and x64: .dmg and .pkg
- Linux x64: .AppImage and .deb

Public beta installers remain unsigned. Windows SmartScreen or macOS Gatekeeper may show an unknown-publisher warning. Verify downloads against SHA256SUMS.
